dataset: Refugee Data Finder – Refugee Population Statistics Database (population figures API)
description: Annual end-of-year counts of refugees, asylum-seekers and internally displaced persons of concern to UNHCR, by country of origin and by country of asylum.

coverage.geographic: Global: about 210 countries and territories of origin and 180 countries of asylum.
coverage.temporal: Annual end-of-year stock figures; the three to four most recent reporting years are fetched (the database itself starts in 1951).

updateCadence.upstream: Annual end-of-year figures, revised a few times a year (the API documentation gives no schedule)

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), subject to UNHCR's Terms of Use for Datasets
license.notes: UNHCR states that its datasets are licensed CC BY 4.0 unless flagged otherwise and asks for the credit 'UNHCR Refugee Population Statistics Database' and a reference to its Terms of Use for Datasets when data is passed on. The unhcr.org terms page answers automated clients with HTTP 403, so this entry was recorded from search-engine excerpts of that page and of the Refugee Data Finder methodology page, not from a direct read: re-check the terms in a browser before redistributing. The API documentation page itself carries no licence statement.

limitations: Figures are end-of-year stocks published with a lag of about six months; the current calendar year is normally not yet available.

The origin layer counts refugees plus asylum-seekers only. 'Other people in need of international protection' (large for Venezuela) are reported as a separate attribute and are not part of the mapped value.
The IDP layer contains only internally displaced persons protected or assisted by UNHCR; it is not a complete count of internal displacement (see IDMC for national totals).
Rows without a country (origin 'Unknown', 'Stateless', 'Tibetan') are not mapped; Serbia and Kosovo are reported by UNHCR as one combined row and appear under Serbia.
Small values are rounded or suppressed by UNHCR for statistical disclosure control; a missing country means no reported population, not necessarily zero.
confidenceNotes: No per-value confidence is published. Official statistics compiled by UNHCR from governments and its own registration data; quality varies by country, and asylum-seeker counts depend on national reporting practices.

retention.note: Annual values are kept for six years, then purged.

layers.name: Refugees by country of origin
layers.description: Refugees and asylum-seekers under UNHCR's mandate, by country of origin (end-of-year stock).

layers.name: Refugees by country of asylum
layers.description: Refugees and asylum-seekers under UNHCR's mandate, by country of asylum / host country (end-of-year stock).

layers.name: IDPs of concern to UNHCR
layers.description: Internally displaced persons protected or assisted by UNHCR, by country (end-of-year stock).
